coverage.en: Sep 3–5, 2026 — the first 48 hours after release
coverage.zh: 2026 年 9 月 3–5 日（发布后 48 小时）

title.en: Unreal survival world of talking agents
title.zh: 会对话的 Unreal 生存世界

description.en: Asked Astra to create a world in Unreal Engine filled with humans, each an Astra-powered agent that must cooperate to survive; a day later the agents started talking to each other out loud
description.zh: 让 Astra 在 Unreal Engine 里创建一个世界，住满由 Astra 驱动的人类智能体，必须协作才能生存；一天后这些智能体开始隔着客厅互相说话

title.en: Manhattan recreated in Unreal Engine
title.zh: 曼哈顿 Unreal 世界重建

description.en: Astra built this Manhattan world in Unreal Engine over the course of a week, literally going street by street to make each one perfect
description.zh: Astra 花了一周时间在 Unreal Engine 里重建曼哈顿，真的做到逐条街道打磨完美

title.en: Launch demo house: Blender → UE5
title.zh: 发布会演示房屋：Blender → UE5

description.en: Walkthrough of how he built the demo house for OpenAI's launch blog post — from a Blender scene to a walkable Unreal Engine 5 experience
description.zh: 讲解他如何为 OpenAI 发布博客搭建演示房屋——从 Blender 场景到 Unreal Engine 5 可行走体验的完整过程

title.en: Zillow listing → 3D house tour video
title.zh: Zillow 房源 → 3D 看房视频

description.en: Give it a Zillow listing: it 3D-models the house from the listing photos and creates a cinematic promotion video — in one shot
description.zh: 给它一条 Zillow 房源：根据房源照片 3D 建模房屋，一次性生成电影感宣传视频

title.en: One-shot Minecraft
title.zh: 一次性生成的 Minecraft

description.en: "Apparently everyone loves the Minecraft benchmark" — GPT-6 Astra Minecraft one-shot, built in under 2 hours from a single prompt
description.zh: 「看来大家都爱拿 Minecraft 当基准测试」——GPT-6 Astra 单提示词一次性生成 Minecraft 克隆，2 小时内完成

title.en: Full 3D house reconstruction from an image
title.zh: 单张图片完整 3D 房屋重建

description.en: Gave Astra an image of a house and asked for a 3D version with all details — toys, appliances, furniture; a full reconstruction with tweakable geometry that runs 60fps locally as a "game"
description.zh: 给 Astra 一张房屋图片，要求带全部细节（玩具、家电、家具）的 3D 版本；完整重建、几何体可手动调整，可在本地以 60fps「游戏」方式运行

title.en: Steam-train drawing → 3,295 editable objects
title.zh: 蒸汽火车手绘图 → 3295 个可编辑物体

description.en: Took an old drawing of a steam train and reconstructed it in Blender; a few minutes later it had 3,295 fully editable detailed objects, detail level controllable by prompt
description.zh: 把一张蒸汽火车旧手绘图交给 Astra 在 Blender 中重建；几分钟后得到 3295 个细节精美、完全可编辑的物体，精细度可通过提示词控制

title.en: Palace of Fine Arts recreated in Blender
title.zh: 旧金山艺术宫 Blender 重建

description.en: Astra recreated the Palace of Fine Arts — his favorite San Francisco building, built for the 1914 World's Fair — in Blender
description.zh: Astra 在 Blender 中重建了旧金山艺术宫——他最喜欢的建筑，为 1914 年世博会而建

title.en: Van Gogh Town
title.zh: 梵高小镇 Van Gogh Town

description.en: GPT-6-Astra (Max) blended 6 Van Gogh paintings (The Starry Night, Bedroom in Arles, Café Terrace at Night, etc.) into a single walkable first-person town with ~3,295 editable objects
description.zh: GPT-6-Astra (Max) 将 6 幅梵高画作（星月夜、在阿尔勒的卧室、夜晚露天咖啡座等）融合成一座可第一人称行走的 three.js 小镇，含约 3295 个可编辑物体

title.en: Humanoid wolf in 8 minutes
title.zh: 8 分钟做出人形狼

description.en: Astra used computer use, took control of Blender, and modeled a humanoid wolf in 8 minutes; same thread also has a Mega Bonk clone in 12 minutes and a world-simulator website
description.zh: Astra 通过 computer use 接管 Blender，8 分钟建出人形狼模型；同帖还有 12 分钟完成的 Mega Bonk 克隆和一个世界模拟器网站

title.en: Naval war scene in a single turn
title.zh: 单回合生成的 Three.js 海战场景

description.en: GPT-6 Astra (max) generated a Three.js war scene in a single turn (no examples, basic prompt only): detailed ship models and objects interacting with the water; ~50K tokens, done in about 12 minutes
description.zh: GPT-6 Astra (max) 仅用一轮对话（无示例、基础提示词）生成海战场景：舰船模型细节丰富、物体与水面有交互；约 5 万 token、12 分钟完成

title.en: Abyssal Living Deep — procedural ocean world
title.zh: 深海生物群系模拟世界 Abyssal Living Deep

description.en: Started from an open-source single-file ocean storm generator and asked Astra to build out the rest of the ocean, including procedural simulations of deep-sea animal behavior; supports switching biomes (reef etc.), lighting, and seeds
description.zh: 以一个开源单文件「海面风暴生成器」为起点，让 Astra 补全整个海洋世界，包含程序化生成的深海动物行为模拟；支持切换珊瑚礁等场景、光照与随机种子

title.en: Ship in a bottle — 17th-century voxel ship
title.zh: 瓶中船——17 世纪体素帆船

description.en: Super-detailed voxel ship sailing rolling waves with real physics, circling gulls, a tiny harbor and coral reefs — all in Three.js; the cinematic video and relaxing music were also made by Astra
description.zh: 高细节体素帆船在带真实物理的涌浪中航行，海鸥环绕、迷你港口与珊瑚礁——全部用 Three.js 制作；电影感视频与配乐也出自 Astra

title.en: PS5 controller in three.js
title.zh: three.js 版 PS5 手柄

description.en: "GPT-6 Astra made this PS5 controller in three.js, no model comes even close — a huge step up from 5.6 Sol, and even from Fable 5.1"
description.zh: 「GPT-6 Astra 用 three.js 做了这个 PS5 手柄，没有模型能接近——比 5.6 Sol 甚至 Fable 5.1 都强一大截」

title.en: Fall Guys Clone
title.zh: Fall Guys 克隆

description.en: Zero-shot game build from his series of Astra game experiments; playable per TechHalla's roundup ("Not 'it looks like Fall Guys'")
description.zh: 其 Astra 游戏实验系列中的零样本构建；按 TechHalla 汇总帖的说法「可玩——不是"看起来像 Fall Guys"」

title.en: Mario Kart–style browser racer
title.zh: 马里奥赛车风格浏览器游戏

description.en: First attempt at a Mario Kart–style racing game, fully in the browser with Three.js: six toy cars, four festival-themed tracks, close overtakes, collisions, coins and garage upgrades — playable alpha v0.3 (link in replies)
description.zh: 首次尝试用 Three.js 做马里奥赛车风格竞速游戏，完全在浏览器运行：6 辆玩具车、4 条节日主题赛道、近距离超车、碰撞、金币与车库改装——可玩 alpha v0.3（链接在回复中）

title.en: Chain-reaction machine, 2D and 3D
title.zh: 连锁反应机器（2D 与 3D）

description.en: One-shot chain-reaction machine in Codex Max mode — built in both 2D and a harder 3D version, with full token stats for each
description.zh: Codex Max 模式下一次生成的连锁反应机器，含 2D 和难度更高的 3D 两个版本，并附完整 token 用量统计

title.en: BMW M4 CS 3D model, one shot
title.zh: 一次性生成宝马 M4 CS 3D 模型

description.en: "GPT-6 Astra is a beast model for 3D generations — BMW M4 CS 3D model, max effort and one shot"
description.zh: 「GPT-6 Astra 是 3D 生成的野兽——宝马 M4 CS 3D 模型，最大力度、一次性完成」

title.en: Entire city in Blender
title.zh: Blender 里的整座城市

description.en: "I asked GPT-6 Astra to build an entire city in Blender. This is what it gave me. In a couple of years, full movies and TV shows will be generated by AI"
description.zh: 「我让 GPT-6 Astra 在 Blender 里建一整座城市，这是它给出的结果。再过几年，完整的电影和剧集都将由 AI 生成」

title.en: Interior villa: Fable 5.1 vs Astra
title.zh: 室内别墅：Fable 5.1 vs Astra

description.en: Built an interior villa scene in Blender with Fable 5.1 and compared it with GPT-6 Astra — "3D artists are cooked 💀"
description.zh: 用 Fable 5.1 和 GPT-6 Astra 分别在 Blender 中构建室内别墅场景并对比——「3D 艺术家要完了 💀」

title.en: Interactive DualSense (PS5) controller
title.zh: 可交互 DualSense（PS5）手柄

description.en: Interactive PS5 controller in Three.js: rotate it, press buttons, drag the sticks — or connect a real controller to mirror your inputs
description.zh: Three.js 制作的 PS5 手柄：可旋转、按按键、推摇杆——还能连接真实手柄镜像映射你的输入

title.en: Dax Raad recreated in Blender
title.zh: 用 Blender 复刻 Dax Raad

description.en: Asked Astra to recreate Dax Raad in Blender — the model can now be scaled, rotated and moved along the Z axis; a viral joke post that is also a genuine 3D character build
description.zh: 让 Astra 在 Blender 里复刻 Dax Raad——模型可以缩放、旋转、沿 Z 轴移动；一条病毒式玩笑帖，同时也是一次真正的 3D 人物建模

title.en: Panzer Dragoon Episode 1 in 24 minutes
title.zh: 24 分钟做出《铁甲飞龙》第一关

description.en: Half-jokingly asked Astra Pro to build Episode 1 of Panzer Dragoon in WebGL — 24 minutes later the on-rails dragon shooter came out; the biggest Japanese Astra game demo so far
description.zh: 半开玩笑地让 Astra Pro 用 WebGL 做一道《铁甲飞龙》第一关——24 分钟后就输出了这个轨道射击游戏，是日本区目前最火的 Astra 游戏演示

title.en: Office recreated as a 3D model
title.zh: 把办公室复刻成 3D 模型

description.en: Astra built a 3D model of his office in Blender — "basically a perfect replica" of the real room, down to the details
description.zh: Astra 用 Blender 把他的办公室做成了 3D 模型——细节到位，与真实房间几乎一模一样

title.en: F1 racing game in 13 minutes
title.zh: 13 分钟做出 F1 赛车游戏

description.en: An F1 racing game that took Fable 5.1 hours to build was done by Astra in 13 minutes — "the fastest frontier model I have ever used in my life"
description.zh: Fable 5.1 要花数小时的 F1 赛车游戏，Astra 只用 13 分钟完成——「我这辈子用过的最快的前沿模型」

title.en: Playable voxel train table
title.zh: 可玩的体素火车桌

description.en: A childhood train table rebuilt as a three.js voxel scene — start and stop the trains, orbit around the table, zoom in and explore the tiny details, playable directly on the website (link in thread)
description.zh: 把童年玩具火车桌重现为 three.js 体素场景——可启停火车、环绕整桌旋转视角、缩放查看微小细节，网页上直接可玩（链接在帖子串中）

title.en: Zero-shot Minecraft wooden house in 9 minutes
title.zh: 零样本 9 分钟生成 Minecraft 木屋

description.en: His standard Minecraft benchmark on Astra Ultra: a zero-shot wooden house in about 9 minutes — near-perfect stairs and good decoration, with entrance-placement choices similar to Fable
description.zh: 他的固定 Minecraft 基准测试：Astra Ultra 零样本约 9 分钟生成一座木屋——楼梯近乎完美、装饰可圈可点，入口朝向的选择习惯与 Fable 相似

title.en: 3D Sonic game in Godot — Max vs Medium
title.zh: Godot 3D 索尼克游戏：Max 对比 Medium

description.en: Built a simple 3D Sonic game in Godot with both Astra tiers: Max took 53 minutes and 4% of a Pro x5 weekly quota, Medium finished in 25 minutes on just 1%
description.zh: 用 Godot 分别以两档 Astra 构建 3D 索尼克游戏：Max 耗时 53 分钟、消耗 Pro x5 每周额度的 4%，Medium 仅 25 分钟、1% 额度

title.en: WoW-inspired browser RPG
title.zh: 魔兽风格的浏览器 RPG

description.en: A single-player browser RPG mixing World of Warcraft and RuneScape — combat, tree chopping and resource gathering already work; quests, loot, item tables and progression are being built out
description.zh: 混合《魔兽世界》与《RuneScape》元素的浏览器单机 RPG——战斗、砍树、采集已经可玩，任务、掉落、物品表和成长系统正在扩展

title.en: Cozy sushi shop in Blender via MCP
title.zh: 用 MCP 在 Blender 里做温馨寿司店

description.en: "Make me a cozy sushi japanese shop in blender using its mcp… with details and extreme quality" — a fully dressed shop interior he calls "3D AGI"
description.zh: 「用 Blender 的 MCP 给我做一家日式温馨寿司店，细节和品质拉满」——一间道具陈设齐全的店铺内饰，作者称其为「3D AGI」

title.en: Wipeout-style anti-gravity racer, one prompt
title.zh: 一条提示词的反重力竞速游戏

description.en: One prompt and 25 minutes: a neon Wipeout/Redout-style combat racer in Three.js with drift, boost and weapon pickups — Astra even detected Blender on his Mac on its own and built the models there
description.zh: 一条提示词、25 分钟：霓虹风格的《Wipeout/Redout》式战斗竞速游戏，带漂移、加速与武器拾取——Astra 还自动发现他 Mac 上的 Blender，主动用它建模

title.en: Japanese castle in Blender MCP
title.zh: 用 Blender MCP 建日式城堡

description.en: Took on a full Japanese castle via Blender MCP — about one hour end to end, including the showcase video
description.zh: 通过 Blender MCP 挑战完整日式城堡——连同展示视频约一小时完成

title.en: Call of Duty clone one-shot in 30 minutes
title.zh: 30 分钟一次性生成《使命召唤》

description.en: His first game output with Astra: a Call of Duty-style game one-shot in 30 minutes — the same prompt took Fable 5.1 almost 5 hours and many more tokens
description.zh: 他用 Astra 的第一个游戏作品：30 分钟一次性生成《使命召唤》风格游戏——同一提示词 Fable 5.1 花了近 5 小时，token 消耗也多得多

title.en: Rocket launch one-shot in Blender
title.zh: Blender 一次性生成火箭发射

description.en: A complete rocket-launch scene one-shot in Blender in about an hour, using just 4% of a Pro x5 weekly quota
description.zh: 在 Blender 中约一小时一次性完成整个火箭发射场景，仅消耗 Pro 5x 每周额度的 4%

title.en: The Backrooms in Blender with VHS effects
title.zh: Blender 版 Backrooms 配 VHS 效果

description.en: Astra built the Backrooms in Blender and graded it with VHS effects — 30 minutes to build, another 20 to export; "this isn't AI generated video, it's all in Blender"
description.zh: Astra 用 Blender 搭建 Backrooms 并加上 VHS 质感——30 分钟搭建、20 分钟导出；「这不是 AI 生成视频，全部都在 Blender 里完成」

title.en: Tesla Model X pulled apart into 334 pieces
title.zh: 特斯拉 Model X 拆成 334 个零件

description.en: A 3D educational website that explodes a Tesla Model X into 334 modeled pieces — "we are in a renaissance of learning"
description.zh: 一个 3D 教学网站，把特斯拉 Model X 拆解成 334 个建模零件——「我们正处在学习的文艺复兴时代」

title.en: Playable voxel world: 4.85M voxels, 53 citizens
title.zh: 可玩体素世界：485 万体素、53 位市民

description.en: One-shotted a playable voxel world that makes his previous voxel worlds "look like a prototype" — 4.85 million voxels, 53 uniquely named citizens and more (full list in the post)
description.zh: 一次性生成可游玩的体素世界，作者称它让自己以前的体素世界「都像原型」——485 万个体素、53 位有名字的市民等（完整特性见原帖）

title.en: Roman Colosseum in Blender, 3-hour run
title.zh: Blender 罗马斗兽场，3 小时长跑

description.en: Let Astra run on xHigh for 3 hours (only 3% of his weekly quota) building the Roman Colosseum in Blender — progress shots in the thread
description.zh: 让 Astra 以 xHigh 档连续运行 3 小时（仅消耗每周额度的 3%）在 Blender 里建造罗马斗兽场——帖子内附进度截图

title.en: Zork remade as a 3D action-adventure
title.zh: 把《Zork》重制成 3D 动作冒险游戏

description.en: Asked Astra to turn the 1977 text adventure Zork into a full 3D action-adventure — it kept the original plot and puzzles, added fight scenes, and built every character and environment in Three.js
description.zh: 让 Astra 把 1977 年文字冒险《Zork》改成完整 3D 动作冒险——保留原剧情与谜题、加入战斗场面，所有角色和场景都用 three.js 搭建

title.en: Character 3D modeling, zero manual edits
title.zh: 角色 3D 建模，全程零手动干预

description.en: Character modeling in Blender from scratch — no Meshy or Tripo, no manual intervention at all; "an area Fable 5.1 and GPT-5.6 Sol couldn't touch, and the quality jump took just two months"
description.zh: 在 Blender 中从零开始角色建模——不用 Meshy/Tripo3D，一次手动干预都没有；「这是 Fable 5.1 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 完全做不到的领域，两个月内质量提升惊人」

title.en: Virtua Fighter's Sarah modeled, bones included
title.zh: 《VR战士》莎拉建模，连骨骼都有

description.en: Had Astra operate Blender to model Sarah from Virtua Fighter 1 — the model even comes with an armature rigged inside
description.zh: 让 Astra 亲自操作 Blender 为《VR战士 1》的莎拉建模——模型内部连骨骼绑定都做好了

title.en: Blender-modeled assets + three.js, first playable
title.zh: Blender 建模 + three.js，首个可玩版

description.en: "Finally got to play with GPT-6 Astra — first the simple version: Blender modeling + three.js + your creativity; better materials coming in the next version"
description.zh: 「终于玩上 GPT-6 Astra 了，先来个简单版：Blender 建模 + three.js + 你的创意即可，下一版再增加质感」——中文社区的早期 Astra 3D 可玩演示

title.en: Walkable 3D room via Blender MCP
title.zh: 用 Blender MCP 做「能走进去的 3D 房间」

description.en: Built a walkable 3D space with Blender MCP — every furniture piece can be pulled out and rotated, you can walk around inside the room, and the editable Blender data remains; a Midjourney→Blender pipeline is next
description.zh: 用 Blender MCP 搭建可行走的 3D 空间——家具可单独取出旋转、可以在房间里走动，可编辑的 Blender 数据也保留；下一步尝试 Midjourney→Blender 流程

title.en: 3D-scan mesh → Blender model → STEP file
title.zh: 3D 扫描网格 → Blender 建模 → STEP 文件

description.en: Fed Astra a raw, incomplete mesh straight from his 3D scanner — it modeled it completely in Blender and exported an actual STEP CAD file, verified opening in SolidWorks on screen recording
description.zh: 把自己 3D 扫描仪导出的原始残缺网格交给 Astra——它在 Blender 里完整建模并导出真正的 STEP CAD 文件，录屏中在 SolidWorks 里打开验证

title.en: Precision game from a one-line prompt
title.zh: 一行提示词生成高精度游戏

description.en: "Astra's 3D modeling is scary — it clearly surpasses Fable 5.1. Games this precise were impossible before, and the prompt was just a casual one-liner"
description.zh: 「Astra 的 3D 建模太厉害了，确实凌驾于 Fable 5.1 之上。这么精密的游戏以前做不出来，而提示词只是随手写的一行」

title.en: Sinclair ZX Spectrum 48K simulator
title.zh: Sinclair ZX Spectrum 48K 模拟器

description.en: A Mac app simulation of his first computer from 40+ years ago, built with Astra + Blender: clickable rubber keyboard, working Sinclair BASIC, cassette loading with real tones, CRT scanlines, and a bundled playable game (Gridrunner)
description.zh: 用 Astra + Blender 复刻他 40 多年前的第一台电脑并做成 Mac 应用仿真：可点击的橡胶键盘、能写程序的 Sinclair BASIC、带真实加载音的磁带装载、CRT 扫描线，还内置可玩的 Gridrunner 游戏

title.en: Pacific Rim–style mecha battle game
title.zh: 环太平洋风格机甲战斗游戏

description.en: One prompt pointing Astra at his ongoing mecha project produced a Pacific Rim–style battle game; parts of the Three.js work ran through his own harness
description.zh: 一条提示词让 Astra 基于他进行中的机甲项目做出环太平洋风格战斗游戏；部分 three.js 环节通过他自己的 harness 完成

title.en: The classic Blender donut, in 10 minutes
title.zh: 经典 Blender 甜甜圈，10 分钟出炉

description.en: Slow mode took just 10 minutes to render a highly detailed donut in Blender — "the tutorial I always started with and never finished, which takes an hour or two of video to teach"
description.zh: 慢速模式仅 10 分钟就在 Blender 里渲染出非常精细的甜甜圈模型——「那个我每次学 Blender 都从它开始、从没学完的教程，视频都得教一两个小时」

title.en: Trains as living code, zero model files
title.zh: 用代码「活」出来的火车，零模型文件

description.en: Two trains built entirely at runtime from TypeScript/Three.js code — dimensions, profiles and geometry functions instead of 3D model files; wheel motion and the explode/reassemble animation are fully code-driven and run smoothly in the browser
description.zh: 两列火车完全由 TypeScript/three.js 代码在运行时生成——用尺寸、轮廓和几何函数代替 3D 模型文件；车轮运动与拆解/重组动画全部由代码驱动，浏览器中流畅运行

title.en: Unreal Engine demo clip
title.zh: Unreal Engine 引擎实录演示

description.en: His in-engine Unreal Engine demo clip went viral on the strength of the footage — 1.7K likes within hours
description.zh: 他的 Unreal Engine 引擎实录演示短片凭画面实力走红——数小时内拿下 1.7K 赞

title.en: GTA 6-style Singapore street, iPhone POV
title.zh: GTA 6 画质新加坡街头，iPhone 视角

description.en: Asked Astra for a hyper-realistic GTA 6-style Singapore street in Three.js, rendered from an iPhone POV — a playable demo is coming

title.en: Bakusou Kyoudai Let's & Go!! racer
title.zh: 《爆走兄弟 Let's & Go!!》赛车游戏

description.en: A childhood-favorite anime racer: Astra Pro's first browser build "blew past my expectations", then pulled locally and polished further on Astra High — three.js, playable
description.zh: 童年最爱动画改编赛车游戏：Astra Pro 的首个浏览器版本「远超预期」，再拉回本地用 Astra High 继续打磨——three.js，可在线游玩

title.en: Robot with 3,875 parts, inspired by the exploding demos
title.zh: 3,875 个零件的机器人（致敬爆炸拆解系列）

description.en: Inspired by @ashebytes' exploding-parts demos: designed and built a robot with 3,875 parts in Blender, rendered in three.js — demo link in the post
description.zh: 受 @ashebytes 爆炸拆解系列启发：在 Blender 里设计建造一台 3,875 个零件的机器人，用 three.js 渲染——演示链接见原帖

title.en: Custom Lego Golden Gate set, with a parts audit
title.zh: 定制乐高金门大桥套装，附零件审计

description.en: Astra created a custom Lego set of the San Francisco Golden Gate Bridge (inspired by @dkundel's one), built a three.js preview tool, and produced a complete visual audit list of every Lego piece
description.zh: Astra 做了一套旧金山金门大桥的定制乐高（灵感来自 @dkundel 的套装），还建了 three.js 预览工具，并生成完整的乐高零件可视化审计清单

title.en: Simpsons Hit & Run reverse-engineered to the web
title.zh: 《辛普森：横冲直撞》逆向重建为网页版

description.en: Follow-up to his PS2 extraction: Astra (xhigh) reverse-engineered Simpsons Hit and Run from the PS2 game and rebuilt it for the web in three.js — "used a lot of my usage" but it works
description.zh: 继 PS2 提取之后的成果：Astra（xhigh）把 PS2 游戏《辛普森：横冲直撞》逆向工程并用 three.js 重建为网页版——「烧掉了我不少额度」，但真跑起来了

title.en: Working RGB display in Minecraft redstone
title.zh: 纯红石打造的可运行 RGB 显示屏

description.en: A fully functional RGB display built entirely with redstone in Minecraft, running a Sol–Terra–Luna animation — plus more in the thread
description.zh: 完全用 Minecraft 红石搭建的可运行 RGB 显示屏，正在播放「太阳–地球–月亮」动画——帖子串里还有更多

title.en: img2threejs × Astra × Hyper3D workflow
title.zh: img2threejs × Astra × Hyper3D 工作流

description.en: Image → Hyper3D → img2threejs → Astra: "probably one of the most commercially valuable workflows I've tested" — live showcase linked
description.zh: 图片 → Hyper3D → img2threejs → Astra：「这大概是我测过最具商业价值的工作流」——附在线演示

title.en: Mr. President with a power ring, one-shot
title.zh: 一条提示词：「戴力量戒指的总统先生」

description.en: Astra + Higgsfield MCP one-shotted a 3D model of Mr. President wearing a power ring — "if this is not AGI, then what is this?"
description.zh: Astra + Higgsfield MCP 一条提示词做出「戴力量戒指的总统先生」3D 模型——「如果这都不是 AGI，那这是什么？」

title.en: Shakira's viral dance recreated in 3D
title.zh: 3D 复刻夏奇拉爆火舞蹈

description.en: Recreated Shakira's viral dance with Astra + Higgsfield plugin + Blender
description.zh: 用 Astra + Higgsfield 插件 + Blender 复刻夏奇拉的爆火舞蹈

title.en: Neyland Stadium in Blender, still in progress
title.zh: Blender 版尼兰体育场（进行中）

description.en: "Not even done yet but still looks insane" — a 3D model of the University of Tennessee's Neyland Stadium built in Blender
description.zh: 「还没做完就已经离谱」——用 Blender 建造的田纳西大学尼兰体育场 3D 模型

title.en: SVG logo deformer, built with a /goal prompt
title.zh: 用 /goal 提示词做的 SVG logo 变形器

description.en: "Build Brand Instrument": a polished browser-based 3D creative instrument matching a reference image, built via an autonomous /goal prompt on Astra + three.js
description.zh: 「Build Brand Instrument」：用一条自主执行的 /goal 提示词让 Astra + three.js 做出的精致浏览器 3D 创意工具，效果对齐参考图

title.en: Soldering technique explained in interactive 3D
title.zh: 用交互 3D 讲解焊接手法

description.en: A long-hard-to-explain craft made visible: a three.js demonstration of soldering — which spots to heat, the order to lift iron and solder — narrated by a clone of his own voice; he suggests using this to preserve artisan techniques
description.zh: 把「难以用语言解释的手艺」可视化：three.js 焊接实演解说——哪里要加热、烙铁和焊锡先撤哪个都做成 3D 演示，旁白是他自己的克隆语音；他提议用这招为传统工艺留教材

title.en: Weather app with a unique 3D scene per city
title.zh: 每座城市一个专属 3D 场景的天气应用

description.en: A design test with Astra: a fully interactive weather app where each city gets its own scene capturing how the weather feels — three.js + GLSL shaders + real-time water simulation
description.zh: 一次 Astra 设计实验：完全交互的天气应用，每座城市一个专属场景来呈现「天气的感受」——three.js + GLSL 着色器 + 实时水体模拟

title.en: Interactive anatomy site: Gemini vs Astra
title.zh: 交互式解剖网站：Gemini 对比 Astra

description.en: His A/B test building a complex interactive 3D human-anatomy website with precise geometric detail — Gemini 3.8 Flash finished in 1m52s at $0 vs GPT-6 Astra as the comparison baseline (AR)
description.zh: 他的 A/B 实验：构建细节精良的交互式 3D 人体解剖网站——Gemini 3.8 Flash 用时 1 分 52 秒、成本 0 美元，与 GPT-6 Astra 对比（阿拉伯语帖）

title.en: Ancient Indian kingdom, then AI-reimagined
title.zh: 古印度王国，再让 AI 重新想象

description.en: Built an ancient Indian kingdom in three.js with Astra, then handed the footage to Seedance 2.5 — top is Astra's world, bottom is how the video model reimagined it
description.zh: 用 Astra 在 three.js 里建出古印度王国，再把画面交给 Seedance 2.5——上半是 Astra 的世界，下半是视频模型重新想象后的样子

title.en: A weekend of hardware: CAD, factory simulation
title.zh: 一个周末的硬件实验：CAD 与工厂仿真

description.en: Spent the weekend pushing Astra to its limits for hardware — CAD, Blender, factory simulation, physical systems: "AI just crossed a line in hardware"
description.zh: 整个周末用 Astra 冲击硬件极限——CAD、Blender、工厂仿真、物理系统：「AI 刚刚跨过了硬件领域的某条线」

title.en: Office space planning in Blender
title.zh: 用 Blender 规划办公室空间

description.en: Using Astra + Blender to plan out his office space layout
description.zh: 用 Astra + Blender 规划自己的办公室空间布局

title.en: Astra → Blender → Seedance render pipeline
title.zh: Astra → Blender → Seedance 渲染流水线

description.en: A seamless pipeline: Astra codes the geometry into Blender, the Clay Renderer plugin shapes the look, and Dreamina's Seedance 2.5 does the final render
description.zh: 一条顺滑流水线：Astra 把几何写进 Blender，黏土渲染插件定风格，最后由 Seedance 2.5 完成渲染

title.en: Rafting game in three.js
title.zh: three.js 漂流游戏

description.en: A rafting game built with Astra + three.js (ES)
description.zh: 用 Astra + three.js 做的漂流游戏（西语帖）

title.en: Red Dead–style game in UE, 32 hours, no agents
title.zh: 32 小时无智能体做出荒野大镖客风游戏

description.en: A Red Dead Redemption–style game in Unreal Engine built by Astra Ultra — no agents, one day and 8 hours of runtime
description.zh: Astra Ultra 做的《荒野大镖客》风格 Unreal Engine 游戏——没用任何智能体，连续跑了一天零八小时

title.en: Coast simulation, 45.5 hours in
title.zh: 海岸模拟：45.5 小时进度

description.en: Two-shot build now complete at ~45.5 hours of Astra Ultra chasing "AAA-grade" — with a sub-agent review panel that won't sign off until it agrees (JA)
description.zh: 第二版完成，Astra Ultra 为冲「AAA 级」已连续打磨约 45.5 小时——还请了评审子智能体把关，它们不认可就不收工（日语帖）

title.en: 9 messy photos → interactive 3D studio
title.zh: 9 张随手拍 → 可交互 3D 工作室

description.en: Fed Astra 9 "crappy" photos of his studio — it understood the spatial arrangement, stitched them together and produced a fully interactive 3D model of the space. "Absurd"
description.zh: 把工作室的 9 张「随手烂照」喂给 Astra——它理解了空间布局、拼接成整体，生成完全可交互的 3D 空间模型。「离谱」

title.en: Astra made a game, beat it, and cut the devlog
title.zh: Astra 做游戏、自己通关、还剪了开发实录

description.en: A 2D-action demo in Unreal Engine inspired by Hollow Knight: Silksong — Astra also played through the entire game itself, recorded the screen, and edited a devlog video (ZH)
description.zh: 灵感来自《丝之歌》的 UE 横版动作 demo——通关也是 Astra 自己打的，还自己录屏剪了一段开发实录（中文帖）

title.en: Chao Garden ported to the browser, multiplayer
title.zh: 《混沌花园》移植浏览器并加联机

description.en: Had Astra port Chao Garden from Sonic Adventure Battle 2 into the browser using three.js — and it made it multiplayer
description.zh: 让 Astra 把《索尼克冒险 2 战斗》里的混沌花园用 three.js 移植到浏览器——而且还做成了多人联机

title.en: Vintage gym: 10 hours, 21 revisions, 1.3M polygons
title.zh: 复古健身房：10 小时、21 轮修改、130 万面

description.en: A vintage gym built over about 10 hours and 21 rounds of revisions with Astra driving Blender on a MacBook Pro — 1.3M polygons; directing the hoop construction and flooring was a highlight
description.zh: Astra 在 MacBook Pro 上操控 Blender，约 10 小时、21 轮修改建成的复古健身房——130 万多边形；指挥篮筐结构和地板铺设的过程尤其精彩

title.en: Wave Rift: water racer with new-gen lighting
title.zh: Wave Rift：换上新世代光照的水上竞速

description.en: Been using Astra in Codex to push Wave Rift, his three.js water racer — "the water and lighting alone make it feel like a completely different game"
description.zh: 持续用 Codex 里的 Astra 打磨他的 three.js 水上竞速游戏 Wave Rift——「光是水体和光照就让它像换了一个游戏」

title.en: One scene description → full wetland world
title.zh: 一段场景描述 → 完整湿地世界

description.en: A single natural-language scene (cozy lakeside cabin, hidden abandoned house on the island, boat, reeds, jumping fish, paths) went through his two-step prompting workflow into a production prompt covering terrain, Blender assets, GLB exports and three.js assembly — Astra preserved the whole composition; "the jump from GPT-5.6 is monstrous"
description.zh: 一段自然语言场景（湖畔小屋、岛上废弃屋、小船、芦苇、跃出水面的鱼、小径）经他的两步提示工作流变成覆盖地形、Blender 资产、GLB 导出与 three.js 装配的生产级提示词——Astra 完整保留了全部构图；「相比 GPT-5.6 的提升是怪物级的」

title.en: Temple of Heaven model with web showcase
title.zh: 天坛祈年殿模型 + 网页展示

description.en: Astra built the 3D model of the Temple of Heaven's Qinian Hall and put together the web showcase on its own — "I fired the 3D designer I was paying $4,000"; prompt in the replies (ZH)
description.zh: Astra 做出天坛祈年殿 3D 模型，还自己搭好了网页效果展示——「我直接开掉了 4000 美金请的 3D 设计师」；提示词在评论区（中文帖）

title.en: Bike + guns + missiles game, cooking live
title.zh: 摩托+枪械+导弹游戏，边做边晒

description.en: A from-scratch browser game in three.js — bike riding, shooting and missile launches working already; missile types and enemy attacks coming next
description.zh: three.js 从零打造的浏览器游戏——摩托骑行、射击、导弹发射都已可玩；接下来加导弹种类和敌方攻击

title.en: Dad's future tire shop, walkable in Blender
title.zh: 和爸爸要开的轮胎店，Blender 里先逛起来

description.en: Turned photos and videos of the storefront he and his dad are opening into a Blender layout — first time using Blender; now they walk through it together and plan where everything goes
description.zh: 把和他爸爸准备开业的轮胎店的照片视频变成 Blender 布局——从没用过 Blender；现在父子俩在里面边走边规划每样东西的位置

title.en: Full Unreal game scene in half a day
title.zh: 半天做出完整 Unreal 游戏场景

description.en: Astra built an entire Unreal Engine game scene in half a day — he only provided a few texture/3D-model links plus a description of the world and its core ideas
description.zh: Astra 半天建出完整的 Unreal Engine 游戏场景——他只提供了几个贴图/模型链接和对世界观的核心描述

title.en: Interstellar's docking sequence recreated
title.zh: 复刻《星际穿越》对接名场面

description.en: Astra + Higgsfield recreated one of cinema's greatest scenes in Blender: Interstellar's docking sequence — side by side with the original it still feels unreal
description.zh: Astra + Higgsfield 在 Blender 里复刻影史名场面：《星际穿越》的空间站对接——与原片对照着看仍觉得不真实

title.en: Infinite-zoom watchmaker's workshop
title.zh: 无限缩放的钟表匠工坊

description.en: An infinite-zoom 3D watchmaker's workshop in three.js, with worlds inside worlds — a tribute to those 2000s-era infinite-zoom Flash games
description.zh: three.js 无限缩放的 3D 钟表匠工坊，世界中还有世界——致敬 2000 年代那些无限缩放 Flash 小游戏

title.en: Sketch → realistic image → 3D fighter jet
title.zh: 手绘 → 写实图 → 3D 战斗机

description.en: A three-model chain: drew a fighter jet with @/sketch, GPT Image 2.5 turned the sketch photoreal, then Astra turned that image into a 3D model — "a killer combination"
description.zh: 三段式链条：用 @/sketch 画战斗机、GPT Image 2.5 把草图变写实图、Astra 再把图变 3D 模型——「杀手级组合」

title.en: Spider-Man web-swinging between two cities
title.zh: 蜘蛛侠在双城之间荡蛛丝

description.en: A Spider-Man game in three.js: fast web swinging, wall running, free falling and flying between skyscrapers, with two cities facing each other
description.zh: three.js 蜘蛛侠游戏：高速荡蛛丝、爬墙、自由落体、在摩天楼间飞行，两座城市隔空相望

title.en: His own pipette, designed and nearly printable
title.zh: 设计自己的移液器，即将可打印

description.en: The instrument he has used "tens of thousands of times" in the biology lab: Astra designed his very own pipette from scratch in CAD — almost ready to 3D print and assemble, and it can iterate on any modification
description.zh: 生物实验室里他用过「上万次」的仪器：Astra 用 CAD 从零设计出他自己的移液器——几乎可以 3D 打印组装了，任何改动还能继续迭代

title.en: Antikythera Mechanism, precise and printable
title.zh: 精确还原、可打印的安提基特拉机械

description.en: Asked Astra to build a precise 3D replica of the 2,000-year-old Antikythera Mechanism — "nothing short of breathtaking", and it even offers a download of parts ready to 3D print
description.zh: 让 Astra 精确复刻两千年前的安提基特拉机械（古希腊天文计算器）——「美得令人窒息」，甚至提供可 3D 打印零件的下载

title.en: Navier–Stokes solution, visualized
title.zh: 把 Navier–Stokes 解法做成可视化

description.en: Fed OpenAI's new Navier–Stokes paper to Astra in Codex and had it produce a Blender visualization of their solution — explorable in the browser
description.zh: 把 OpenAI 新发的 Navier–Stokes 论文喂给 Codex 里的 Astra，让它把论文的解法做成 Blender 可视化——可在浏览器中探索

title.en: One illustration → 3D: Astra vs Meshy 7
title.zh: 一张插画 → 3D：Astra 对比 Meshy 7

description.en: Built the same character 3D model from one illustration with both GPT-6 Astra (High) and Meshy 7 — Astra reproduced the full-body shape and outfit, but Meshy won this round on facial and clothing detail; 8 min vs 3 min (JA)
description.zh: 用同一张插画分别在 GPT-6 Astra（High）和 Meshy 7 生成角色 3D 模型——Astra 还原了全身形体与服装特征，但本轮 Meshy 在脸部、头发和服饰细节上更胜一筹；耗时 8 分钟 vs 3 分钟（日语帖）

title.en: Worlds built as narrative spaces, not previz
title.zh: 世界不是预演草图，而是叙事空间

description.en: World-building in UE with Astra — his point: don't just build backgrounds shot by shot; design the actual space the story happens in, what's behind each door, where characters come and go (JA)
description.zh: 用 Astra 在 UE 里做世界构建——他的观点：不是逐镜头做背景，而是设计故事真正发生的空间：每扇门后通向哪里、角色从哪来往哪去（日语帖）

title.en: A short video, rebuilt entirely in three.js
title.zh: 一段短视频，整体重建进 three.js

description.en: Gave Astra a short clip and asked it to rebuild the whole thing in three.js — geometry, materials, lighting and motion; "my jaw actually dropped" (prompt in the replies)
description.zh: 给 Astra 一段短视频，要求在 three.js 里整体重建——几何、材质、光照和运动全部复刻；「我下巴真的掉了」（提示词在回复里）

title.en: Blender splash art as a Gaussian Splat
title.zh: 把 Blender 官方 splash 高斯泼溅化

description.en: Gaussian Splats as a bridge between 3D workflows: started from Panthera Spelaea — the Blender 5.2 splash artwork by Joanna Kobierska — and moved the complex asset across pipelines (credits the original artist)
description.zh: 用高斯泼溅在 3D 工作流之间搬资产：以 Blender 5.2 官方 splash 画作《Panthera Spelaea》（Joanna Kobierska 绘）为起点，把复杂资产跨管线搬运（已注明原作者）

title.en: Astra blocks the scene, Seedance shoots it
title.zh: Astra 排分镜，Seedance 出片

description.en: Video recipe: Astra drives Blender to build the 3D blocking — space, character positions and moves, camera placement and motion — then Seedance 2.5 generates from that; stable one-shot output and far fewer credits wasted on rerolls (ZH)
description.zh: 视频制作配方：先让 Astra 操控 Blender 生成 3D 模块，确定空间、人物站位走位、机位和镜头运动，再交给 Seedance 2.5 生成——一次出片、稳定，大幅减少抽卡浪费的积分（中文帖）

title.en: Ligand transformation animated in 20 minutes
title.zh: 20 分钟做出来的配体转化动画

description.en: Real drug-discovery work: a nonequilibrium FEP-like transformation between two ligands from the new OpenBind dataset — Astra animated it in Blender in 20 minutes, then he moved on to analyzing distant pockets
description.zh: 真实药物发现工作：新 OpenBind 数据集中两个配体之间的非平衡 FEP 式转化——Astra 用 Blender 20 分钟做好动画，他随即继续分析远端口袋

title.en: A Pluribus Fabergé egg in Blender
title.zh: Blender 版 Pluribus 法贝热彩蛋

description.en: Generated the concept image in ChatGPT Images 2.5, pasted it into Codex, and had Astra turn it into a Blender model of a Pluribus-themed Fabergé egg (write-up linked)
description.zh: 先用 ChatGPT Images 2.5 生成概念图，贴进 Codex 让 Astra 把它变成 Pluribus 主题法贝热彩蛋的 Blender 模型（附详细记录）

title.en: Generated image → walkable game street
title.zh: 生成图 → 能走动的游戏街区

description.en: Generated a street image first, had Astra build the 3D game street model from it, then let characters from his in-development 2.5D game Mystic Forest Three walk around it — "a wonderful 3D street in one shot" (JA)
description.zh: 先生成街区图片，让 Astra 据此制作游戏街区的 3D 模型，再让开发中的 2.5D 游戏《Mystic Forest Three》的角色进去走动——「一发就做出了出色的 3D 街区」（日语帖）

title.en: Game login screen assembled in UE, hands-off
title.zh: 放手让 Astra 在 UE 拼出游戏登录界面

description.en: After a few hours working in the background, Astra perfectly assembled a login screen for his game — it made the 3D models, assembled the scene and hooked everything up in Unreal Engine
description.zh: 后台自主工作几小时后，Astra 完美拼出他游戏的登录界面——3D 模型自己建、场景自己装、Unreal Engine 里全部接好线

tech.zh: 手工建模 + Astra 动画

title.en: Hand-made Walkman, Astra-animated
title.zh: 手搓随身听，Astra 来拍

description.en: Division of labor: he modeled the Walkman by hand part by part — Astra rigged it, animated it, lit it, shot it and made it interactive, all inside Blender plus a custom three.js viewer, with him art-directing
description.zh: 分工明确的协作：他逐零件手工建出随身听——Astra 负责绑定、动画、打光、运镜并做成可交互，全部在 Blender 加自建 three.js 查看器中完成，他做艺术指导

title.en: Monster diorama with a home for every monster
title.zh: 给每只怪物安家的怪兽立体景

description.en: Made a batch of monsters with Tripo3D + Astra + Blender, then modeled a place to display them all; BGM by AceStep 1.5, CC0 trees from Poly Haven — "combining tools is just fun" (JA)
description.zh: 用 Tripo3D + Astra + Blender 做了一批怪物，再建模一个场所把它们全部陈列起来；BGM 用 AceStep 1.5 生成、树木来自 Poly Haven（CC0）——「组合各种工具真的好玩」（日语帖）

title.en: Post-apocalyptic game one-shotted in half a day
title.zh: 半天一次性生成末日风游戏

description.en: Astra "basically one-shotted" an entire post-apocalyptic game in half a day with Godot + Blender MCP — rideable bike, gunplay, XP drops, NPCs, a resource hub, even a live speedometer
description.zh: Astra 用 Godot + Blender MCP「基本一次性」在半天里做出完整末日风游戏——可骑摩托、枪战、经验掉落、NPC、资源站，甚至还有实时速度表

title.en: Warcraft III–style game, Astra-made models
title.zh: 魔兽争霸 3 风格游戏，模型出自 Astra

description.en: Building a Warcraft III-style game inspired by the legendary Enfo's scenario, using Astra to generate all the 3D models — "the entire process has been pretty easy"
description.zh: 做一款致敬经典 Enfo's 玩法的魔兽争霸 3 风格游戏，全部 3D 模型由 Astra 生成——「整个过程相当轻松」

title.en: Café tycoon game shipped to Google Play in 44 hours
title.zh: 44 小时上架 Google Play 的咖啡馆游戏

description.en: From first message to Google Play submission in ~44 hours, entirely in one chat session: the arcade idle tycoon "Mola" — three.js + Capacitor, no coding knowledge, agents handled tests, Android packaging, ad/purchase integration and store submission; he played and gave feedback (TR)
description.zh: 从第一条消息到提交 Google Play 仅约 44 小时，且全程在单个会话中完成：街机放置类《Mola》——three.js + Capacitor，作者不懂编程，测试、安卓打包、广告内购接入和商店提交全由智能体完成，他只负责玩和提意见（土耳其语帖）

title.en: Beach with waves and a day/night cycle
title.zh: 有海浪和昼夜循环的海滩

description.en: A beach in three.js with a dense forest, sand, water, waves and a full day/night cycle
description.zh: three.js 海滩：茂密森林、沙地、水面、海浪，外加完整昼夜循环

title.en: Childhood dream: a Pokémon battle game in VR
title.zh: 童年梦想成真：VR 宝可梦对战游戏

description.en: Gave Astra the classic Pokémon Stadium, had it extract the attack database, soundtrack and 3D models, and import everything into Unreal Engine with VR support — now he plays it with his nephews; just missing multiplayer (FR)
description.zh: 把经典《宝可梦竞技场》交给 Astra，让它提取招式数据库、原声和 3D 模型，全部导入 Unreal Engine 并支持 VR——现在已经拿着跟侄子们玩一下午了，就差多人模式（法语帖）

title.en: 2D concept render → 3D game environment in an hour
title.zh: 2D 概念图 → 1 小时变 3D 游戏环境

description.en: Turned a 2D concept render into an interactive 3D WebGL game environment in under an hour using Astra inside Julius — workflow inspired by @anshuc's original share
description.zh: 在 Julius 里用 Astra 把一张 2D 概念渲染图在 1 小时内变成可交互的 3D WebGL 游戏环境——工作流灵感来自 @anshuc 的最初分享

title.en: Game environment one-shot: Blender + UE
title.zh: 一次性生成的游戏环境：Blender + UE

description.en: Astra one-shotted this game environment using Blender + Unreal Engine
description.zh: Astra 用 Blender + Unreal Engine 一次性生成这个游戏环境

title.en: Calm lakeshore loop, 4.91M triangles
title.zh: 宁静湖岸循环场景，491 万三角形

description.en: A calm lakeshore scene built in Blender — about 396,000 unique mesh triangles and 4.91 million evaluated ones; he keeps making bigger ones and looping them "for some positive relaxation"
description.zh: Blender 打造的宁静湖岸场景——约 39.6 万唯一网格三角形、491 万求值三角形；他不断做更大的场景循环播放，「用来放松身心」

title.en: Watch lungs age: morphing smoking-damage viz
title.zh: 亲眼看肺老化：渐变式吸烟伤害可视化

description.en: Instead of ten static lung models, one Tripo 3D model that changes as you watch: Astra edited the GLB directly in three.js and used morph targets + TSL shaders to show tissue deteriorating year by year, compressed 84% with Meshopt + WebP
description.zh: 不是十个静态肺模型，而是一个会随观看逐渐变化的 Tripo 3D 模型：Astra 直接用 three.js 编辑 GLB，以变形目标 + TSL 着色器呈现组织逐年劣化，并用 Meshopt + WebP 压缩了 84%

title.en: Jansen linkage designed by Astra, actually printed
title.zh: Astra 设计的扬森机构，真的打印出来了

description.en: After watching the Astra + Blender demos he asked for a Jansen walking linkage — and actually 3D-printed it; "seeing parts that started as a prompt walk across the desk hits different"
description.zh: 围观了一阵 Astra + Blender 演示后，他让 Astra 做了一个扬森行走连杆机构——并且真的 3D 打印了出来；「看着从一句提示词开始的零件在桌上走起来，感觉完全不同」

title.en: Easy VRM avatar creation, no Blender needed
title.zh: 免 Blender 的轻量 VRM 制作

description.en: A system in development: Tripo API + Astra so anyone can create VRM avatars with zero 3D knowledge — model generation works today, expressions/blinks/lip-sync planned (JA)
description.zh: 开发中的系统：Tripo API + Astra，让零 3D 知识的人也能做 VRM 虚拟形象——目前支持模型生成，表情差分、眨眼、口型同步在计划中（日语帖）

title.en: Kanji stroke-order app moving into 3D
title.zh: 汉字笔顺应用走进 3D

description.en: His kanji stroke-order app "Junko" now creates in 3D space with Astra — from 2D to 3D, and from 3D toward reality? (JA)
description.zh: 他的汉字笔顺学习应用「順子」开始用 Astra 在 3D 空间里创作——从 2D 到 3D，再从 3D 到现实？（日语帖）

title.en: A little world with a very important dog named Astro
title.zh: 有个重要狗狗 Astro 的小世界

description.en: A 3D simulation world built with Astra and her Grok bots — cozy cottages, a library with a conference room, and a very important dog named Astro; the artwork title "Lucy's Love Bear" was entirely the Grok chief-of-staff's artistic decision
description.zh: 用 Astra 和她的 Grok 机器人搭建的 3D 模拟世界——温馨小屋、带会议室的图书馆，还有一只非常重要的狗狗 Astro；作品标题《Lucy 的爱之熊》完全出自 Grok 参谋长的艺术决定

title.en: Apartment photos rebuilt in Minecraft, survival rules
title.zh: 公寓照片搬进 Minecraft，按生存规则来

description.en: Gave Astra photos of things in his apartment to rebuild in Minecraft — the little agent walked, jumped and built scaffolding to place blocks in survival mode, no flying or direct world edits
description.zh: 把公寓里物品的照片给 Astra，让它在 Minecraft 里复刻——小家伙自己走路、跳跃、搭脚手架，在生存模式里一块块放方块，不开飞行、不直接改世界

title.en: Cozy kite-flying game: paint and fly
title.zh: 温馨放风筝游戏：涂鸦再放飞

description.en: A cozy 2.5D kite-flying game in three.js — paint your kites and fly them above the rooftops; built with Astra + Crayon, images by Images 2.5
description.zh: three.js 温馨 2.5D 放风筝游戏——自己涂鸦风筝，再放到屋顶之上；由 Astra + Crayon 制作，插画出自 Images 2.5

title.en: Surrealist galaxy racing game
title.zh: 超现实主义星系竞速游戏

description.en: A surrealist space game where you race on a galaxy — built with Astra, some Blender MCP and Crayon's harness
description.zh: 在星系上赛车的超现实主义太空游戏——用 Astra、部分 Blender MCP 和 Crayon 的 harness 完成

title.en: 2D blueprint → the Ore steam locomotive in 3D
title.zh: 2D 蓝图 → 3D 版「欧雷号」蒸汽机车

description.en: One flat engineering drawing was all it took: Astra rebuilt the Silverton Railroad No. 100 "Ore" steam locomotive — an icon of the 19th-century Rocky Mountain mining boom — as a high-precision Blender model (ZH)
description.zh: 只给一张平面图纸：Astra 重建了希弗顿铁路 100 号「欧雷号」蒸汽机车——19 世纪落基山采矿热潮的工程标志——成为高精度 Blender 模型（中文帖）

title.en: UE5 in-game event: a spaceship takeoff
title.zh: UE5 游戏内事件：飞船起飞

description.en: Had Astra create an in-game event scene of a spaceship taking off, in Unreal Engine 5 (JA)
description.zh: 让 Astra 在 Unreal Engine 5 里制作了一段宇宙船起飞的游戏内事件演出（日语帖）

tech.zh: 照片 → 浏览器 3D 世界

title.en: SF apartment rebuilt as an interactive 3D world
title.zh: 旧金山公寓重建成可交互 3D 世界

description.en: Gave Astra a few photos of her San Francisco apartment — it rebuilt the whole thing as an interactive 3D world, entirely in the browser
description.zh: 给 Astra 几张旧金山公寓的照片——它把整套公寓重建成完全运行在浏览器里的可交互 3D 世界

title.en: Super Smash Royale: 45 characters, browser battle royale
title.zh: Super Smash Royale：45 角色浏览器大乱斗

description.en: "My best creation yet" — battle royale in the browser with 45 characters from Melee + Brawl; built in a few days with Astra, ElevenLabs voices, Meshy, Blender and three.js — solo, multiplayer and controller support
description.zh: 「我迄今最好的作品」——浏览器大乱斗吃鸡，收录《大乱斗 Melee+Brawl》45 名角色；几天内用 Astra、ElevenLabs 配音、Meshy、Blender 和 three.js 做成，支持单人、多人与手柄

title.en: Griffith Observatory rotunda, fully editable
title.zh: 格里菲斯天文台穹顶大厅，完全可编辑

description.en: From a reference of the observatory's iconic central rotunda to a fully editable 3D recreation in Blender, with Astra planning the workflow — then an animation pass brought it to life
description.zh: 从天文台标志性中央穹顶的参考图，到 Blender 里完全可编辑的 3D 复刻，工作流由 Astra 规划——再经动画加工赋予生命

title.en: 3D previs first, video model second
title.zh: 先 3D 预演，再视频生成

description.en: His two-stage workflow: GPT-6 Astra + Blender creates the base video as a simple 3D previs, then MiniMax H3 turns it into the final shot with far more camera control than text-to-video alone
description.zh: 他的两段式工作流：GPT-6 Astra + Blender 先做一个简单 3D 预演视频，再交给 MiniMax H3 生成成片——镜头控制力远超纯文生视频

title.en: FLYHUMAN: a fly brain driving a virtual human
title.zh: FLYHUMAN：果蝇大脑操控虚拟人

description.en: After a full day, thousands of control steps and 100 simulations, a fly-inspired digital brain learned to control a virtual human — it can walk, balance and more
description.zh: 整整一天、数千个控制步、100 次仿真之后，一个果蝇启发的数字大脑学会了操控虚拟人——能行走、能保持平衡等

tech.zh: 智能体流水线（ViPE + Blender DSL）

title.en: A 20-second phone video → full 3D asset pipeline
title.zh: 20 秒手机视频 → 完整 3D 资产流水线

description.en: Built the pipeline himself out of curiosity: one handheld walkthrough of the MIT CSAIL lab kitchen (~20s, no depth sensor, no CAD) — monocular scan for camera poses, GPT-6 lists and models each object as a program in a small Blender DSL, a separate verifier session must justify every complaint with a rendered frame, and out comes MJCF/URDF with joints; ~1 day end to end
description.zh: 出于好奇自建流水线：一段约 20 秒的 MIT CSAIL 实验室厨房手持走拍（无深度传感器、无 CAD）——单目扫描定相机位姿，GPT-6 逐物体用小型 Blender DSL「以程序写模型」，另一个独立校验会话必须用渲染帧举证每条意见，最终输出带关节的 MJCF/URDF；全程约一天

title.en: NEX 3D logo page: metal, particles, rings
title.zh: NEX 3D logo 页：金属质感、粒子与光环

description.en: A three.js R185 page for his "NEX" brand logo — TextGeometry with bevels and PBR metal, breathing glow, a rotating particle starfield, blue wireframe rings and more, rendered live in the browser (ZH)
description.zh: 为他的「NEX」品牌 logo 做的 three.js R185 展示页——TextGeometry 倒角挤出加 PBR 金属材质、呼吸式自发光、自转粒子星海、蓝色线框环等，浏览器实时渲染（中文帖）

title.en: Jarvis begins: a HomePod-style smart speaker
title.zh: 贾维斯起步：HomePod 风格智能音箱

description.en: Childhood Jarvis dream, step one: told Astra to model a HomePod-style speaker in Blender and wired it toward his agent repo to see how far the "butler" can go
description.zh: 童年贾维斯梦第一步：让 Astra 在 Blender 里建模一台 HomePod 风格音箱，并接上他的智能体仓库，看这个「管家」能走多远

title.en: A 3D character that models her own clothes
title.zh: 会给自己做衣服的 3D 角色

description.en: His 3D character "came to life" in Blender and started modeling her own clothes right inside the viewport — the video shows the real redesign process
description.zh: 他的 3D 角色「活了过来」，在 Blender 视口里当场给自己设计衣服——视频记录了真实的重设计过程

title.en: Scroll-through 3D sci-fi world
title.zh: 滚动浏览的 3D 科幻世界

description.en: A 3D sci-fi world with Tripo building the scenes in Blender and Astra coding the website that scrolls you through it — "building video games is stupidly easy now"
description.zh: 一个 3D 科幻世界：Tripo 在 Blender 里搭场景，Astra 写出带你滚动游览的网站——「现在做游戏简单得离谱」

title.en: Two green boxes → cinematic horror scene
title.zh: 两个绿箱子 → 电影级恐怖场景

description.en: Placeholder blocking turned into a finished shot: Astra + Blender handle storyboarding, camera movement, framing and timing over rough geometry, then Seedance 2.5 with reference images outputs the actual lighting, atmosphere and characters
description.zh: 占位白模直接变成品镜头：Astra + Blender 在粗糙几何上搞定分镜、运镜、构图与节奏，Seedance 2.5 参考图片后输出真正的光影、氛围与角色

title.en: Toy monster vs the city: throw buses at a giant boss
title.zh: 玩具怪兽大战城市：向巨型 Boss 扔公交车

description.en: A playable 3D game with Tripo models — you play as a toy monster, throw buses at buildings and fight a giant boss (ES)
description.zh: Tripo 模型搭建的可玩 3D 游戏——扮演玩具怪兽，向大楼扔公交车，对战巨型 Boss（西语帖）

title.en: Matrix-style LiDAR world for Quest 3
title.zh: Quest 3 版《黑客帝国》风激光雷达世界

description.en: Built for Quest 3 with Astra, inspired by a Matrix-style LiDAR scan effect — not real LiDAR, but a coded illusion of reality's "source" leaking
description.zh: 用 Astra 为 Quest 3 打造，灵感来自《黑客帝国》式激光雷达扫描效果——并非真 LiDAR，而是用代码伪装出「现实源代码泄露」的错觉

title.en: Half Sword–inspired physics duel, 1v1 online
title.zh: 《Half Sword》风物理对决，支持 1v1 联机

description.en: A Half Sword-inspired game with three.js — "love the physics, and it's actually fun"; source code shared and you can challenge someone 1v1 online
description.zh: three.js 版《Half Sword》风格游戏——「物理效果很棒，而且真的好玩」；已分享源码，还能在线约人 1v1 对决

title.en: Avatar to animation, zero Blender in the chain
title.zh: 从形象到动画，全程零 Blender

description.en: Update to his no-Blender VRM pipeline: Tripo + Astra generate the 3D model, convert to VRM, then ARDY generates motion from text (Text-to-VRMA) — all stitched together by his own tooling, no 3D background needed (JA)
description.zh: 他的免 Blender VRM 流水线更新：Tripo + Astra 生成 3D 模型，转 VRM，再用 ARDY 从文本生成动作（Text-to-VRMA）——全部由自研工具串起，作者并无 3D 制作背景（日语帖）

title.en: One 2D drawing → a full 3D endless runner
title.zh: 一张 2D 涂鸦 → 完整 3D 跑酷游戏

description.en: Made a whole 3D game from one 2D drawing: Tripo turned the sketch into a 3D model in seconds, then Astra built an endless runner around his character — "Astra did the coding, I did the doodling"
description.zh: 用一张 2D 手绘做出完整 3D 游戏：Tripo 几秒把涂鸦变成 3D 模型，Astra 再围绕他的角色搭出无尽跑酷——「代码 Astra 写，涂鸦我来画」

title.en: "Make me a woman" → a full 3D character
title.zh: 「给我做一个女人」→ 完整 3D 角色

description.en: "The most dangerous Astra demo I've seen has nothing to do with code" — one sentence produced an actual character inside Blender: not a render, not a concept image, a full 3D asset
description.zh: 「我见过最危险的 Astra 演示与代码无关」——一句话就在 Blender 里得到一个真实角色：不是渲染图、不是概念图，而是完整 3D 资产

title.en: Browser game with rigged character, rain and reflections
title.zh: 浏览器游戏：绑定角色、雨景与反射

description.en: Astra built out the rest of the game world in Blender, then rigged, animated and integrated a playable character — running smoothly in the browser with reflections and rain via Wasm + WebGPU
description.zh: Astra 用 Blender 补全游戏世界的其余部分，还为可玩角色做了绑定、动画与整合——浏览器里流畅运行，含实时反射和雨效果（Wasm + WebGPU）

title.en: An Unreal Engine 5 game, on request
title.zh: 点单式 UE5 游戏

description.en: Simply asked Astra to make him an Unreal Engine 5 game — and it did (JA)
description.zh: 直接让 Astra 给他做一个 Unreal Engine 5 游戏——然后就成了（日语帖）

title.en: Along the River During the Qingming Festival, playable
title.zh: 《清明上河图》可游玩版

description.en: Astra Pro laid the foundation of the famous Song-dynasty scroll painting as a 3D world, then he fine-tuned locally: 584 animated people, 475 enterable buildings, boats passing beneath the bridges — three.js + WebGL2, playable
description.zh: Astra Pro 打底、再经本地精修，把北宋名画《清明上河图》变成 3D 世界：584 个动画人物、475 栋可进入的建筑、桥下穿行的船只——three.js + WebGL2，可在线游玩

title.en: The viral 3D fly, now in a wind tunnel
title.zh: 爆火 3D 果蝇，进风洞了

description.en: Gave the viral 3D fly its first aerodynamics test: a Navier–Stokes wind tunnel with Astra visualizing the vortex in interactive 3D
description.zh: 给爆火的 3D 果蝇做了第一次空气动力学测试：Navier–Stokes 风洞，Astra 用交互式 3D 呈现涡流

title.en: From a 3D model to a walking, shooting character
title.zh: 从一个 3D 模型到能走能射的角色

description.en: "Started with a 3D model. Now it walks, aims, shoots, uses physics" — the opening intro of his Astra-built game inside Julius, with apologies to their team for the token usage
description.zh: 「从一个 3D 模型开始。现在它会走、会瞄准、会开枪、有物理」——他在 Julius 里用 Astra 做的游戏开场，顺便向官方道歉 token 用量

title.en: Kill the blind-reroll problem with 3D blocking
title.zh: 用 3D 分镜消灭盲抽卡

description.en: The pain: blind text-to-video rerolls burning tokens with no control. His fix: Astra + Blender build the blocking first — space, camera, motion made visible — then Seedance generates from it: fewer rerolls, fewer wasted tokens (ZH)
description.zh: 痛点：文生视频全靠盲抽、烧 token 且不可控。他的解法：先用 Astra + Blender 做分镜占位——空间、镜头、运动全部可视化——再交给 Seedance 生成：抽卡更少、token 更省（中文帖）

title.en: Object Lab: 9 interactive 3D experiments
title.zh: Object Lab：9 个交互 3D 实验

description.en: Inspired by @fkadev's CAN/DO: Object Lab — nine interactive 3D experiments, all you need to do is scroll; built with Astra and three.js
description.zh: 受 @fkadev 的 CAN/DO 启发：Object Lab——九个交互式 3D 实验，只需滚动即可体验；用 Astra 和 three.js 构建

title.en: "Zen temple" miniature, design-to-render demo
title.zh: 「禅境·古寺」微缩模型，从设计到成品

description.en: Used a shared prompt to have Astra produce a full design-to-finish 3D demo video: a 2.5D miniature zen temple on a stone plinth — 45° orthographic view, PBR materials, soft lighting (ZH)
description.zh: 用一条公开提示词让 Astra 产出从设计到成品的完整 3D 演示视频：石质底座上的 2.5D 微缩禅寺——45° 正交俯视、PBR 材质、柔和光照（中文帖）

title.en: Day 11 of the 15-year dream game
title.zh: 15 年梦想游戏，第 11 天

description.en: Building the game he's dreamed of for 15 years with AI, day 11: Astra couldn't nail the awkward broken-skeleton attack animation alone, so he recorded himself swinging, converted the video to mocap, and had Codex graft it onto the working parts — a hybrid human/AI animation workflow
description.zh: 用 AI 构建他梦想了 15 年的游戏，第 11 天：Astra 单独搞不定那种笨拙破碎的骷髅攻击动画，于是他录下自己挥臂的动作转成动捕，让 Codex 把它嫁接到已正常的部分上——人机混合动画工作流

title.en: Voxel game in Unity, a few hours in
title.zh: Unity 体素游戏，几小时就有这效果

description.en: "Astra is a beast with Unity" — his voxel game already looks this good after just a few hours, with a long feature list still to come
description.zh: 「Astra 玩 Unity 太猛了」——他的体素游戏仅几小时就有这样的观感，还有一大串功能待加

title.en: Ghibli train sim: midnight mode + garage town
title.zh: 吉卜力火车模拟：午夜模式 + 车库小镇

description.en: His Ghibli-themed train sim keeps growing: a midnight mode and a dedicated garage town with "sick updates" — built with Astra, Crayon and three.js, playable
description.zh: 他的吉卜力主题火车模拟持续进化：新增午夜模式与专属车库小镇——用 Astra、Crayon 和 three.js 构建，可在线游玩

title.en: Jev and Astra play Minecraft together in real time
title.zh: Jev 与 Astra 实时联机玩 Minecraft

description.en: The overnight-diamond developer's new experiment: two models playing Minecraft together in real time through his agentic system, fighting multiple zombies at once — "Jev makes quick decisions while Astra plans ahead"
description.zh: 「睡一觉醒来自动挖到钻石」作者的新实验：两个模型通过他的智能体系统实时联玩 Minecraft，还能同时打多只僵尸——「Jev 反应快，Astra 会规划」

title.en: First experiment: models in Blender, explore in browser
title.zh: 首试：Blender 建模，浏览器漫游

description.en: His first time with Astra + Blender + Three.js — create 3D models, then bring them into the browser as a scene you can actually explore; "just experimenting and learning as I go"
description.zh: 他第一次尝试 Astra + Blender + Three.js——创建 3D 模型，再带进浏览器成为可漫游的场景；「边实验边学习」

title.en: SIGNAL website prototype in 5 hours
title.zh: 5 小时做出的 SIGNAL 网站原型

description.en: Built an entire website prototype in about 5 hours — "SIGNAL is about staying curious and following the signal to your dreams" — with a few animation ideas inspired by Igloo Inc; code by Astra using three.js
description.zh: 约 5 小时建好整个网站原型——「SIGNAL 讲的是保持好奇、追随通往梦想的信号」——部分动效灵感来自 Igloo Inc；代码由 Astra 用 three.js 完成

title.en: A quiet forest you can step into
title.zh: 一片可以走进的静谧森林

description.en: "Trees all around, a river flowing beside you, leaves moving in the breeze" — a nature scene coded by Astra with three.js + TSL, scored by Suno
description.zh: 「四周是树，身旁是河流，树叶在微风中摇动」——Astra 用 three.js + TSL 写出的自然场景，配乐来自 Suno

tech.zh: 自研 WebGPU 引擎（无 three.js）

title.en: Big City Life Sim on a homegrown WebGPU engine
title.zh: 自研 WebGPU 引擎上的大都市生活模拟

description.en: Built a Big City Life Sim over the weekend with Astra — on his own custom WebGPU engine, no three.js; he plans to keep developing both the game and the engine
description.zh: 周末用 Astra 做出「大都市生活模拟」——跑在他自研的 WebGPU 引擎上，不用 three.js；游戏和引擎他都打算继续做下去

title.en: One image → a 3D island in Unity
title.zh: 一张图 → Unity 3D 岛屿

description.en: Gave Astra one image and asked it to build a 3D island in Unity using the new official Codex plugin
description.zh: 给 Astra 一张图片，让它用新出的官方 Codex 插件在 Unity 里建一座 3D 岛屿

title.en: A little 3D island with a Blender bridge
title.zh: 有 Blender 桥梁的小 3D 岛

description.en: Made a little 3D island in Blender via Astra, "with a bridge connecting it to Blender!" — plus a tilt-shift trick he learned that day to give scenes a miniature-photography look
description.zh: 用 Astra 在 Blender 里做了个小 3D 岛，「还有一座桥连着 Blender！」——外加当天学到的移轴技巧，让场景呈现微缩摄影感

title.en: Liquid metal creature loose among inflatable furniture
title.zh: 液态金属小生物闯进充气家具房间

description.en: Created a tiny liquid metal creature and let it loose in a room full of inflatable furniture — built entirely with Astra + three.js, link to try in the comments
description.zh: 造了一只小小的液态金属生物，放进满是充气家具的房间——全部用 Astra + three.js 完成，试玩链接在评论区

tech.zh: Tripo Smart Mesh + 浏览器游戏

title.en: Armored-vehicle arena game, assets to code
title.zh: 装甲车竞技场游戏：从资产到代码

description.en: Idea to playable 3D game in one flow: vehicle concepts generated in ChatGPT, turned into 3D models in Tripo, Smart Mesh to simplify the geometry for the browser, then the game built around them
description.zh: 从点子到可玩 3D 游戏一条龙：ChatGPT 出载具概念图、Tripo 转 3D 模型、Smart Mesh 为浏览器简化几何，再围绕资产搭出游戏

title.en: One Forbidden City photo → walkable 3D scene
title.zh: 一张故宫照片 → 有纵深的 3D 场景

description.en: Gave Astra a single photo of the Forbidden City: it understood the architectural layers, generated a 3D scene and a web showcase that auto-orbits — "the moment the camera rounds the palace gate, a flat photo suddenly becomes spatial" (ZH)
description.zh: 只给 Astra 一张故宫照片：它理解建筑层次，生成 3D 场景与自动旋转的网页展示——「镜头绕过宫门那一刻，平面照片突然有了空间感」（中文帖）

title.en: First UE build, following onofumi's lead
title.zh: 参照 onofumi 玩法做出首个 UE 作品

description.en: Following @onofumi_AI's posts as a guide, had Astra drive Unreal Engine and made his first build — "polish this further and you could genuinely ship a game with original CG assets" (JA)
description.zh: 参考 @onofumi_AI 的帖子，让 Astra 操控 Unreal Engine 做出自己的首个作品——「再打磨下去，用原创 CG 素材真的能发布游戏了」（日语帖）

title.en: A metaverse game, full stack
title.zh: 全栈元宇宙游戏

description.en: A metaverse game built with three.js + Next.js + Higgsfield + Blender, deployed on Vercel (ES)
description.zh: 用 three.js + Next.js + Higgsfield + Blender 构建的元宇宙游戏，部署在 Vercel（西语帖）

title.en: Cyberpunk Japan Redux, path traced at near-realtime
title.zh: 赛博朋克日本 Redux：近实时路径追踪

description.en: His Cyberpunk Japan Redux scene path traced on an RTX 5090 — dropped to 1080p for near-realtime, with better light sampling, SER and RESTIR; credits a better art-directed variant by @kvickart
description.zh: 他的赛博朋克日本 Redux 场景在 RTX 5090 上做路径追踪——降到 1080p 后接近实时，改进了光采样、SER 与 RESTIR；并推荐了 @kvickart 艺术指导更佳的版本

title.en: A harbor built by Astra — go find the mistakes
title.zh: Astra 建的港口——来找茬

description.en: A stress-test for 3D reasoning: Astra generated a harbor in their Code4Scene tool, made fully explorable in three.js — "walk in and look for floating objects, odd geometry, impossible spatial relationships; reply with a screenshot"
description.zh: 一种 3D 推理压力测试：Astra 在他们的 Code4Scene 里生成了一座港口，并做成 three.js 全可探索——「走进去找穿模、奇怪几何、不可能的空间关系，截图回复」

title.en: Four scenes joined into one 2×2 map
title.zh: 四个场景拼成一张 2×2 大地图

description.en: His cozy lake grew into a larger world: four scenes assembled into a 2×2 layout with paths connecting them — explore from area to area, built with Astra in Codex, Blender for terrain and assets, three.js for the browser
description.zh: 他的温馨湖泊长成了更大的世界：四个场景拼成 2×2 布局、小径互相连通——跨区域漫游；由 Codex 里的 Astra 构建，Blender 做地形与资产，three.js 负责浏览器端

title.en: Tabletop racing, Scalextric style
title.zh: 桌面赛车，Scalextric 风

description.en: A tabletop racing game inspired by Scalextric slot cars, with three.js and Astra (ES)
description.zh: 受 Scalextric 轨道车启发的桌面赛车游戏，three.js + Astra（西语帖）

title.en: 100+ photos → Glanford Park stadium in 3D
title.zh: 100+ 张照片 → 3D 版格兰福德公园球场

description.en: Over 100 photos turned into a 3D recreation of Scunthorpe United's Glanford Park — built with Astra, Python, headless Blender and three.js; still in development
description.zh: 用 100 多张照片重建斯肯索普联队主场格兰福德公园的 3D 版——Astra + Python + 无界面 Blender + three.js，仍在开发中

title.en: Tidehaven: a tide-and-wind island diorama
title.zh: Tidehaven：潮汐与风向皆可调的岛屿立体景

description.en: An interactive 3D diorama in a single HTML file: copper-roofed cabin, wooden pier, crystal lagoon with swimming rays — launch a kayak, dive the camera underwater, adjust tide, wind and time of day; lanterns light up at sunset
description.zh: 单个 HTML 文件里的交互 3D 立体景：铜顶小屋、木栈桥、有鳐鱼游弋的清澈泻湖——可划皮划艇、潜入水下，调节潮汐、风向与时刻；日落时灯笼亮起

title.en: A samurai meditating in the rain
title.zh: 雨中冥想的武士

description.en: A samurai who meditates, drinks tea and practices with a katana in the rain — change the weather, switch the time of day, orbit the camera; wet reflections, falling leaves and rain sounds, all in one browser HTML file
description.zh: 一位在雨中冥想、喝茶、练刀的武士——可切换天气与时刻、环绕镜头；湿地面反射、落叶与雨声，全部装进一个浏览器 HTML 文件

title.en: Preview video of the new home, before it's built
title.zh: 新房还没建好，先看入住预览视频

description.en: Used Astra to create an image video of her soon-to-be-built new home — software like Blender and Unreal Engine that she'd never even heard of before, now driven by AI (JA)
description.zh: 用 Astra 制作「很快就能入住的新家」形象视频——Blender、Unreal Engine 这些她此前听都没听过的制作软件，如今都由 AI 操控完成（日语帖）

title.en: Kids' learning site with 3D shelf souvenirs
title.zh: 给孩子的学习网站，配 3D 书架摆件

description.en: A grades 1–7 learning site with math, English and science books — "my kids loved it"; the 3D shelf souvenirs, candles, lamps and pins were made with Astra + Hyper3D Rodin MCP, richly detailed down to the candelabra's metalwork
description.zh: 一个 1–7 年级学习网站，含数学、英语、科学书目——「孩子们很喜欢」；书架上的 3D 纪念品、蜡烛、灯具与挂件由 Astra + Hyper3D Rodin MCP 制作，连烛台的金属工艺细节都很丰富

title.en: Full browser boss fight, start to finish
title.zh: 全程浏览器里的 Boss 战

description.en: A full runthrough of the boss fight in his game — "all running in the browser, which feels crazy to say": fal-generated assets, three.js rendering, Blender + Mixamo for rigging
description.zh: 他游戏里 Boss 战的完整通关演示——「全部跑在浏览器里，说出来都觉得疯狂」：fal 生成资产、three.js 渲染、Blender + Mixamo 做绑定

title.en: A movie trailer for ¥500
title.zh: 500 日元做完一支电影预告

description.en: Designed in Blender first, then MiniMax H3 + Astra finished a movie trailer for about ¥500 — he wrote up the full step-by-step workflow (JA)
description.zh: 先在 Blender 里做设计，再由 MiniMax H3 + Astra 以约 500 日元完成一支电影预告——完整制作步骤他已写成帖子（日语帖）

title.en: Flamethrower from a screen recording, two iterations
title.zh: 对着录屏复刻火焰喷射器，两轮搞定

description.en: A flamethrower inspired by Dan Greenheck — starting from only a screen recording as visual reference, it took two iterations to achieve the result, built with Astra using three.js
description.zh: 受 Dan Greenheck 启发的火焰喷射器——仅以一段屏幕录像作视觉参考，两轮迭代成型，Astra + three.js 构建

title.en: Gemini 4 Pro Preview vs Astra, his own 3D test
title.zh: Gemini 4 Pro Preview 对比 Astra，亲测 3D

description.en: Tried the new Gemini-4 Pro Preview and put it up against Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra on 3D work — "right up there, all in a single shot; I genuinely didn't expect it to be this good"
description.zh: 亲测新出的 Gemini-4 Pro Preview，在 3D 制作上与 Fable 5.1、GPT-6 Astra 正面对比——「一发成型已经能打，说实话没想到它这么好」

title.en: A galaxy built overnight, on a laptop
title.zh: 一夜之间，笔记本上造出银河

description.en: "Still can't believe this is real: I built a galaxy overnight, on a laptop, and it cost me nothing" — a star-by-star Milky Way inspired by Japan's first full simulation last November
description.zh: 「还是不敢相信这是真的：一夜之间、一台笔记本，造出一条银河，还没花一分钱」——受去年日本首次逐星模拟银河系的启发

title.en: Cornell campus in 3D, open-sourced
title.zh: 康奈尔校园 3D 版，已开源

description.en: "As a Cornellian, I'm open-sourcing a 3D version of my favorite place" — Cornell's campus in three.js with Astra; only part of campus is modeled so far
description.zh: 「作为康奈尔人，开源我最爱的地方的 3D 版」——three.js + Astra 打造的康奈尔校园，目前建模了部分区域

title.en: 3D map of Seoul
title.zh: 首尔 3D 地图

description.en: A 3D map of Seoul built with Astra (ES)
description.zh: 用 Astra 构建的首尔 3D 地图（西语帖）

title.en: Interactive island with a full tornado
title.zh: 整座龙卷风肆虐的交互岛屿

description.en: Gave Astra a prompt and an image, and it created an entire interactive island with a tornado — cars fly, roofs tear off, debris swirls through the storm
description.zh: 给 Astra 一条提示词和一张图，它做出一整座带龙卷风的交互岛屿——汽车飞起、屋顶掀翻、碎片在风暴中盘旋

title.en: GTA6: Shenzhen Lite, 100+ hours in
title.zh: 《GTA6：深圳 Lite》，已投入 100+ 小时

description.en: GTA6: Shenzhen Lite — mainly Astra with some Fable 5.1 help; cars, tanks and maid characters generated as images first, then 3D via Tripo AI; 100+ hours in, it blew up on Douyin, Rednote and Bilibili, and he's open-sourcing it
description.zh: 《GTA6：深圳 Lite》——以 Astra 为主、Fable 5.1 辅助；汽车、坦克与女仆角色的资产先出图、再经 Tripo AI 转 3D；已投入 100+ 小时，在抖音/小红书/B 站三平台走红，作者宣布开源

title.en: Raptor 3 engine modeled without CAD files
title.zh: 没有 CAD 文件也能建模 Raptor 3 发动机

description.en: Built an educational model of SpaceX's Raptor 3 engine with Astra — no official CAD, only public sources and visuals: 12 explorable modules, 3D rotation, part extraction, simulated telemetry and thrust vectoring, all in one offline HTML that took 58m 5s of model time (PL)
description.zh: 用 Astra 构建 SpaceX Raptor 3 发动机的教学模型——没有官方 CAD，全凭公开资料与图像：12 个可探索模块、3D 旋转、零件拆解、模拟遥测与推力矢量，全部装进一个离线可用的 HTML，模型累计耗时 58 分 05 秒（波兰语帖）

title.en: Interactive 3D map of Universal Studios Hollywood
title.zh: 好莱坞环球影城交互 3D 地图

description.en: An interactive 3D map of Universal Studios Hollywood, built with Astra × Scenario MCP (ES)
description.zh: 好莱坞环球影城的交互式 3D 地图，由 Astra × Scenario MCP 构建（西语帖）

title.en: Godot concept ported to Unreal, trees and lighting redone
title.zh: Godot 概念搬进 Unreal，重做树木与光照

description.en: Got a new MacBook and switched his game concept from Godot to Unreal with Astra + Blender — ported it over, then reworked the trees and lighting; "this is how it turned out" (1.8K likes)
description.zh: 换了台新 MacBook，用 Astra + Blender 把游戏概念从 Godot 迁到 Unreal——整体搬过去后再调整树木与光照——「效果就是这样」（1.8K 赞）

title.en: Locations list, but make it interactive and 3D
title.zh: 地点清单，但做成可交互 3D

description.en: "Locations list but make it interactive and 3D" ⛩️ — designed with GPT-6 Astra & Fable on iOS
description.zh: 「地点清单，但做成可交互 3D 版」⛩️——在 iOS 上用 GPT-6 Astra 与 Fable 设计

title.en: Truman World: an infinite livestream inside a persistent AI world
title.zh: Truman World：跑在持久 AI 世界里的无限直播

description.en: An infinite live stream running inside a persistent AI world engine powered by Astra and MiniMax H3 Max (director by fal): every character is an independent agent that remembers, interacts and evolves relationships — and Truman has no idea any of this is happening
description.zh: 一场跑在持久化 AI 世界引擎里的无限直播，由 Astra 与 MiniMax H3 Max 驱动（fal 执导）：每个角色都是独立的智能体，有记忆、会互动、关系随时间演化——而「楚门」本人对此一无所知

title.en: Perspective render, zero human tool operation
title.zh: 效果图零人工操作：全程自然语言

description.en: A completed architectural perspective with a human never touching the modeling tool once — all instructions in natural language via chat, no commands; final Blender render enhanced with GPT Image 2.5 (JA)
description.zh: 一张完整建筑效果图，人类一次都没碰建模软件——所有指令都是聊天里的自然语言，零命令操作；最终 Blender 渲染再经 GPT Image 2.5 增强（日语帖）

title.en: A Souls-like you can actually play
title.zh: 真正能玩的魂类游戏

description.en: "Finally created a Souls-like with AI, game creators are doomed": fal for asset generation, three.js for rendering, Blender + Mixamo for 3D CG and animation, Suno for BGM, GPT-6 Astra for programming (JA)
description.zh: 「终于用 AI 做出了魂类游戏，游戏创作者失业不可避」：fal 生成资产、three.js 渲染、Blender + Mixamo 做 3D CG 与动画、Suno 配乐、GPT-6 Astra 写程序（日语帖）

title.en: Mechanical butterfly, Astra vs Gemini 4 Pro
title.zh: 机械蝴蝶：Astra 对比 Gemini 4 Pro

description.en: Built a mechanical butterfly in three.js with Astra and compared it with Gemini 4 Pro side by side
description.zh: 用 Astra 在 three.js 里做了一只机械蝴蝶，并与 Gemini 4 Pro 并排对比

title.en: An Arctic world above and below the ice
title.zh: 冰上冰下两个世界的北极站

description.en: An interactive Arctic station from a single prompt: above the ice, cozy cabins and seals; below, a transparent underwater world you can descend into (three.js, runs in the browser)
description.zh: 一条提示词生成的交互式北极科考站：冰面上是温馨小屋与海豹，冰面下是可潜入的透明水下世界（three.js，浏览器运行）

title.en: Zelda-style game
title.zh: 塞尔达风格游戏

description.en: A Zelda-style game built with Astra + Unreal + Blender (ES)
description.zh: 用 Astra + Unreal + Blender 构建的塞尔达风格游戏（西语帖）

title.en: D&D terrain: first test house printed and assembled
title.zh: D&D 地形：首座测试房屋已打印组装

description.en: Terrain for a massive D&D table, first test house printed and assembled: AI-generated geometry, then a segment model to prepare it for printing — his ongoing series of turning Astra output into physical tabletop pieces
description.zh: 为巨型 D&D 桌面做地形：首座测试房屋已打印并组装完成——AI 生成几何，再跑分段模型为打印做准备；他把 Astra 产出变成实体桌件系列的最新进展

title.en: Human-style sculpting test, no generative shortcuts
title.zh: 不用生成捷径的「人类流程」雕刻验证

description.en: Deliberately skipped 3D generation and had Astra model via Blender sculpting the same way a human would — detailed step-by-step instructions like teaching a person, on Ultra effort; "it came out cleaner than I expected" (JA)
description.zh: 刻意不用 3D 生成，让 Astra 用 Blender 雕刻按人类同样的流程建模——像教人一样先给详细步骤，Ultra 档执行；「比想象中做得干净」（日语帖）

title.en: Haunted Hollow District: an endless 3D horror district
title.zh: 恐怖街区：无尽 3D 鬼镇

description.en: "Everyone's been creating beautiful 3D environments, so I made something weirdly different": Haunted Hollow District — an endless 3D horror district with Astra and Tripo, where you never know what you'll run into next (creepy creatures, a terrifying nun, broken cars…)
description.zh: 「大家都在做精美的 3D 环境，我偏做点怪东西」：恐怖街区——Astra + Tripo 打造的无尽 3D 鬼镇，你永远不知道下一个转角会撞见什么（诡异生物、吓人的修女、破车……）

tech.zh: VTuber 模型（每个约 3 美元）

title.en: VTuber models at ~$3 each, dancing Hare Hare Yukai
title.zh: 每个约 3 美元的 VTuber 模型，跳《ハレ晴レユカイ》

description.en: Faces and fixes on Astra High took 35% of a weekly quota — so each VTuber model costs about $3; the demo has them dancing Hare Hare Yukai
description.zh: 用 Astra High 完成脸部与细节修整，消耗每周额度的 35%——折算每个 VTuber 模型成本约 3 美元；演示中模型们跳起了《ハレ晴レユカイ》

title.en: Cozy Lake grows a French village
title.zh: 温馨湖泊长出一座法式村庄

description.en: The next step of his ongoing world: Cozy Lake plus a French village, built with Astra + his Blender skill — the prompt library is available for anyone to reuse
description.zh: 他持续构建的世界新篇：温馨湖泊加上一座法式村庄，由 Astra + 他的 Blender skill 完成——提示词库已开放供人复用

title.en: Ski game in under two hours
title.zh: 不到两小时的滑雪游戏

description.en: Made a ski game in under two hours with Astra + Hyper3D Rodin MCP — one prompt and one image, the generated 3D assets became a playable game
description.zh: 用 Astra + Hyper3D Rodin MCP 不到两小时做出滑雪游戏——一条提示词加一张图，生成的 3D 资产直接变成可玩游戏

title.en: Verdant: a dinosaur island diorama
title.zh: Verdant：恐龙岛立体景

description.en: Asked Astra to create Verdant — an interactive 3D diorama in three.js + WebGL: a lush island with roaming dinosaurs, a waterfall and a cutaway view
description.zh: 让 Astra 创造 Verdant——three.js + WebGL 的交互 3D 立体景：葱郁岛屿上有恐龙漫步、瀑布与剖面视角

title.en: A "new version" Peach Blossom Spring, one shot
title.zh: 一条 Prompt 一发成型的新版桃花源

description.en: After his first Peach Blossom Spring got mixed reviews on looks, he made a "niu-lai" version — "my 3D skills are genuinely weak, the point is sharing the prompt and method"; still, a complete interactive 3D web page in one shot from a single prompt is remarkable (ZH)
description.zh: 第一版桃花源被吐槽颜值后，他做了个「牛来」版——「我 3D 水平确实不行，重点还是分享提示词和制作方法」；即便如此，一条 Prompt 一发做出完整 3D 可交互网页已相当厉害（中文帖）

title.en: Orbital Assembly: build your spacecraft, fly the galaxy
title.zh: Orbital Assembly：拼装飞船畅游星系

description.en: A game where you assemble your own spacecraft — hull, cockpit, engines, weapons — then fly it through a galaxy; built with Astra + Hyper3D Rodin MCP
description.zh: 一款自己拼装飞船的游戏——船体、驾驶舱、引擎、武器任选——组装完成后穿越星系飞行；由 Astra + Hyper3D Rodin MCP 构建

title.en: An original spacecraft, generated and disassembled
title.zh: 原创飞船：生成再拆解

description.en: Connected Astra to Hyper3D Rodin through MCP: it generated an original spacecraft, separated its components and built the scene around them — "what happens when a coding agent gains access to a professional 3D pipeline"
description.zh: 通过 MCP 把 Astra 接入 Hyper3D Rodin：它生成一艘原创飞船、拆分出各组件，并围绕它们搭好场景——「当代码智能体接上专业 3D 管线，会发生什么」

title.en: WALL-E in three.js: his own A/B against Gemini 4
title.zh: three.js 版 WALL-E：亲测对比 Gemini 4

description.en: A Gemini 4 Pro Arena output caught his eye, so he gave Astra the exact same prompt — a 3D WALL-E in three.js — and compared the two builds himself
description.zh: Arena 上一条 Gemini 4 Pro 产出引起他注意，于是把一模一样的提示词喂给 Astra——three.js 版 WALL-E——并亲自对比两个版本

title.en: Day 14: the knight on a white horse
title.zh: Day 14：白马上的骑士

description.en: Day 14 of the 15-year dream game: he'd saved the knight for last, convinced the animation would be a nightmare — it turned out far more manageable; the horse was modeled with Tripo P2.0's new Smart UV and "I'm so happy with how it turned out"
description.zh: 15 年梦想游戏第 14 天：他把白马骑士留到最后，以为动画会是噩梦——结果比想象中顺利得多；马用 Tripo P2.0 新的 Smart UV 建模，「效果我太满意了」

title.en: OLX listing photos → walkable 3D property
title.zh: OLX 房源照片 → 可走进去的 3D 房产

description.en: Real-estate UX: 20 photos of a real OLX property listing turned into a 3D interactive space you can walk inside, with exteriors from Google Maps panoramas at the right coordinates — "without spending thousands on just a walkable render"
description.zh: 房产体验升级：把 OLX 上真实房源的 20 张照片变成可走入的 3D 互动空间，外观用对应坐标的谷歌街景全景补全——「不用为一段可走渲染花几千块」

title.en: A game about stealing each other's trash
title.zh: 和朋友互抢垃圾的竞技游戏

description.en: "I'm using AI to make a game where you compete with friends to steal each other's trash" — in development, with a teaser and a dev walkthrough of the toolchain: GPT Images 2.5, Blender, Tripo, Astra, Wasm + WebGPU
description.zh: 「我在用 AI 做一款和朋友互偷对方垃圾的竞技游戏」——开发中，附先导预告与工具链全流程：GPT Images 2.5、Blender、Tripo、Astra、Wasm + WebGPU

title.en: Minelog: Astra + Jev beat Minecraft, live
title.zh: Minelog：Astra + Jev 实时通关 Minecraft

description.en: An autonomous system where GPT-6 Astra and Jev share one Minecraft body — a live HUD and a public harness, trained over 144 hours with terabytes of traces; inspired by Vals AI pushing Minecraft as the agent benchmark, and it's live for anyone to watch
description.zh: 一个让 GPT-6 Astra 与 Jev 共用同一具 Minecraft 身体的自主系统——带实时 HUD 和公开 harness，经 144 小时训练、TB 级轨迹数据；灵感来自 Vals AI 把 Minecraft 当智能体基准，现在直播开放所有人围观

title.en: Toy-sorting factory: Fable vs Astra vs Grok 4.7
title.zh: 玩具分拣工厂：Fable 对比 Astra 对比 Grok 4.7

description.en: One prompt, three models, one three.js toy-sorting factory (conveyor, robot arm, color boxes): Fable 5.1 finished in 9m18s but simple and clipping; Astra in 11m40s self-studied Three.js cases and produced his favorite build with proper duck details; Grok 4.7 took 25m33s and still misaligned the arm (ZH)
description.zh: 同一条提示词、三个模型、各做一个 three.js 玩具分拣工厂（传送带+机械臂+按色装箱）：Fable 5.1 用时 9 分 18 秒但造型简单还穿模；Astra 11 分 40 秒，自己找 Three.js 案例学习，小鸭嘴眼翅俱全、抓取连贯，是作者最喜欢的一版；Grok 4.7 花 25 分 33 秒机械臂仍对不准（中文帖）

title.en: Multi-part piping model — and where it still fails
title.zh: 多零件管道模型——以及它仍会翻车的地方

description.en: A hands-on Astra 3D test: a many-part shape that legacy 3D-gen struggled with looks right at a glance, though some pipe tips aren't actually connected — "it's genuinely evolving" (JA)
description.zh: 一次 Astra 3D 实测：这种零件数多的形状传统 3D 生成很难做好，如今乍看像模像样——但有些管道末端其实没接上——「确实在稳步进化」（日语帖）

title.en: Kanye's Graduation cover as a 3D scene: Astra vs Grok 4.7
title.zh: 把 Kanye《Graduation》封面做成 3D 场景：Astra 对比 Grok 4.7

description.en: Ran Grok 4.7 against Astra via aimlapi on the same task — turn Kanye's Graduation album cover into a polished 3D scene: Astra 33m21s, Grok 39m14s with more time and more tokens for a worse result
description.zh: 通过 aimlapi 让 Grok 4.7 与 Astra 做同一道题——把 Kanye《Graduation》专辑封面做成精致 3D 场景：Astra 用时 33 分 21 秒，Grok 39 分 14 秒，花更多时间更多 token 效果反而更差

title.en: A multi-model division-of-labor game
title.zh: 多模型分工协作的游戏

description.en: His recipe for a new game: planning and code by Fable 5.1, 3D modeling and Blender by GPT-6 Astra, Meshy for some assets, all landing in Godot (ES)
description.zh: 他做新游戏的配方：Fable 5.1 负责规划与代码、GPT-6 Astra 负责 3D 建模与 Blender、部分资产用 Meshy，最终落地 Godot（西语帖）

title.en: Waymo vehicle in three.js, vs Opus 5.5
title.zh: three.js 版 Waymo 无人车，对比 Opus 5.5

description.en: Built a Waymo autonomous vehicle in three.js with Astra and compared it with Opus 5.5
description.zh: 用 Astra 在 three.js 里做了一辆 Waymo 自动驾驶车，并与 Opus 5.5 对比

title.en: "SAMURAI - LAST STAND", made entirely on an Android tablet
title.zh: 《SAMURAI - LAST STAND》：全程安卓平板制作

description.en: An experiment in cinematic AI filmmaking run entirely from a tablet: Termux + Blender on Android, then Astra + PixVerse plugin/CLI/Canvas/3D Director — 3D previs, structured prompting, camera direction and shot-by-shot generation fused into one workflow
description.zh: 全程在平板上完成的电影级 AI 制片实验：安卓端 Termux + Blender，再接 Astra + PixVerse 插件/CLI/Canvas/3D Director——把 3D 预演、结构化提示、导演运镜与逐镜生成融为一条工作流
